# Map Shows Donald Trump’s Approval Rating in Every State After 19 Months

Published

Aug 20, 2026 at 05:00 AM EDT

Khaleda Rahman

National Correspondent

With less than three months to go before November's midterm elections, President Donald Trump's approval rating remains underwater in most states, bar a handful of reliably Republican strongholds that continue to give him positive marks on his job performance.
